name: Tools & Productivity
description: Useful websites, apps, utilities, productivity workflows, document tools, media tools, and everyday digital helpers.

tree.name: Tools
tree.description: Practical digital tools, websites, apps, utilities, and workflows saved for later use.

profile.summary: Use when the primary reason to save the material is a useful tool, app, website, service, or repeatable workflow. Prefer more specific categories for coding tools, AI tools, or physical gadgets.
positive_examples: Tool that simplifies a recurring workflow.
negative_examples: Research paper without a practical tool.

children.name: Useful Websites
children.description: Website lists, web services, directories, online helpers, and browser-based utilities.

profile.summary: Use for saved lists or individual web services that are useful because they are websites: directories, online utilities, browser tools, and web resources.
positive_examples: Collection of websites that simplify life.
negative_examples: AI model release without a website list.

children.name: Apps & Utilities
children.description: Desktop, mobile, browser, and command-line utilities for practical everyday use.

profile.summary: Use for apps and utilities: desktop apps, mobile apps, browser extensions, command-line utilities, and small tools that solve a practical task.
positive_examples: Top useful apps for everyday life.
File exchange app for multiple devices.

children.name: Documents & Presentations
children.description: Tools for presentations, documents, PDFs, reports, writing, formatting, and office workflows.

profile.summary: Use for document and presentation helpers: slide tools, PDF tools, report generators, writing utilities, formatting helpers, and office workflows.
positive_examples: Tool for creating a study presentation.
Repository that writes academic work from text.

children.name: Media Download & Conversion
children.description: Downloaders, cutters, converters, transcoders, capture tools, and media processing utilities.

profile.summary: Use for media utilities: video downloaders, cutters, converters, transcoders, audio/video capture, subtitle tools, and media processing workflows.
positive_examples: Tool for downloading and cutting YouTube videos.

children.name: Productivity Systems
children.description: Task systems, knowledge workflows, notes, habits, time management, and personal operating systems.

profile.summary: Use for productivity methods and systems: task management, note workflows, knowledge organization, personal operating systems, time management, and repeatable routines.
negative_examples: Single useful website without workflow advice.
